newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso closs slightly higher at 1,017.00.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso closs slightly higher at 1,017.00.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed up 45 centavos at 1,017.00 after a day that dealers described as quiet trading on the country's interbank market.
"The market was very calm and there were no large transactions," one dealer said in a telephone interview.
Dealers reported 287 trades for a total of $109 million and said the peso held in a tight 1,017.00-1,018.00 range.
The peso's closing price was the same as on Monday and dealers said they expected mostly rangebound trading for the remainder of the week.
